Choices.Text: 保持 / 轮换 / 停止
恢复默认 / 解除保持

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 抱歉，让你们久等了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这不就是摇篮曲嘛……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……『请告诉我这条消息该怎么回复』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
但你们还是希望能尽早交出来吧
完成得早，就能多练一些

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 那就配合歌词来调整旋律吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我们，是一支乐队吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 就是演出啦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 多听听节奏吉他的声音

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
（有引领最新潮流的新锐曲子，
有朗朗上口的曲子，也有在演出上出彩的曲子……）

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
（梦限大的曲子，我至今也一直在写……
但这次连轮廓都看不见……）

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我们，是最棒的乐队！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
『承蒙关照。
我是梦限大MewType的千石由乃』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
作曲也是一样……
写成歌词，就意味着要直面自己的内心

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
『今天成为MewType了。
新的人生』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好了，工作工作

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 备考我会选择最节能的方式

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 嗯，差不多到乐队练习的时间了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 阿嚏！哈……感冒了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 热死了……不该穿这身衣服

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 办公桌上的冰箱得补充点冰淇淋了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 冷气的温度设定，总是忍不住想去调呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊，虫鸣声……要不要录下来呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 差不多该把厚连帽衫拿出来了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 好冷……！所以我冬天才不想出门

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 积雪了……大家肯定在兴奋地玩雪呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 很久以前提交的圣诞歌曲，原来已经发布了啊
